briefing: - 清单未标记在野利用或勒索软件，暂无公开PoC。
- Adobe、微软、GitLab批量公告，Adobe Web中间件风险最高。
- 最需立即处置：Adobe SSRF与容器/虚拟化漏洞均达CVSS 10。
- 边界设备高危：Fortinet 9.8、Ivanti 9.9，优先排查VPN。
- 微软邮件系统批量修复，含9.3 XSS与8.8授权错误。

cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.description: Wazuh from 4.1.1 before 4.14.8 contains a path traversal vulnerability in upload_list_file, upload_rule_file, and upload_decoder_file that allows malicious cluster workers to write files at arbitrary paths. Attackers holding the cluster key can send DistributedAPI requests with ../ sequences in filename, bypassing REST controller validation, to write files as the wazuh user.

items.description: NVIDIA AIStore for Linux contains a vulnerability in the legacy ETL Kubernetes PodSpec initialization API where a remote attacker may supply Kubernetes host-namespace and container-security settings. items.title: PEP 未授权 代码注入(RCE)
items.description: A fork pull request can therefore supply attacker-authored setup.py or PEP 517 build hooks whose installation code executes in the privileged base-repository workflow with CF_API_TOKEN, GH_TOKEN, MKDOCS_GIT_COMMITTERS_APIKEY, and a write-capable GITHUB_TOKEN, allowing secret disclosure and follow-on compromise. The vulnerability is not caused by the repository-fork guard, and the demonstrated path requires attacker control of fork content rather than merely the artifact metadata.

items.title: Wazuh worker越权覆写配置RCE
items.summary_zh: 控制worker后可利用路径与校验缺陷覆写配置，在管理端及所有agent实现root RCE。
items.action_zh: 升级Wazuh修复版本；限制worker权限并审计配置写入
items.repro_note: 受控worker利用尾斜杠绕过覆写ossec.conf/agent.conf
items.impact_scope: 安全设备管理平台，可控制所有agent
items.description: Wazuh versions from 3.9.0 before 4.14.8 contain an arbitrary file overwrite vulnerability in MasterHandler.process_files_from_worker allowing a cluster worker to overwrite protected master files. Attackers controlling a worker can use a trailing-slash basename bypass and missing extra_valid enforcement to overwrite ossec.conf and agent.conf, achieving root remote code execution across the manager and every agent.

items.title: Wazuh配置校验大小写绕过RCE
items.summary_zh: 拥有manager:update_config权限的认证用户可利用大小写校验差异注入命令，重载后以root执行。
items.action_zh: 升级Wazuh至4.14.8；限制update_config权限
items.repro_note: 认证且具update_config权限，注入大写LOG_FORMAT后重载
items.impact_scope: 安全设备管理端，高权限致root RCE
items.description: Wazuh 4.14.3 before 4.14.8 contains a case-sensitivity mismatch between the ossec.conf validator and wazuh-logcollector that bypasses remote-command validation. Authenticated users with manager:update_config can inject an uppercase LOG_FORMAT command localfile that the collector runs as root on reload.

items.title: CWE-35
items.description: Affected systems do not properly restrict access to internal APIs and paths for authenticated users. This could allow an authenticated remote attacker to access sensitive internal information, which in the worst case could be leveraged to facilitate unauthorized access to the system or result in the deletion of data.

items.title: PHP 代码注入(RCE)
items.description: FearlessCMS is a flat-file content management system centered on simplicity and open source. Because router.php permits existing PHP files under plugins to be executed by the PHP development server, attacker-supplied update content can execute arbitrary PHP with the web server process's privileges and persist as a backdoor.

items.title: Import 任意文件上传
items.description: An authenticated user with Import privileges can select the affected import path and upload a PHP file that remains under an attacker-controlled executable filename, and an import error can leave the file on disk. If the temporary directory is served with PHP execution enabled, requesting the staged file can execute arbitrary PHP code with the web server process privileges, exposing or modifying recruiting data and the host system.

items.title: Activity Log XSS
items.difficulty: 中(远程·需低权限·需用户交互)
items.description: Prior to 0.9.119, the administrator Activity Log in htdocs/js/pages/admin/Activity.js concatenates the attacker-controlled item.user.full_name value into HTML without applying encode_entities and inserts the result through this.div.html. The stored name executes script in an administrator's session when the Activity Log is opened, enabling administrator takeover and subsequent command execution through privileged Cronicle features.
